gloss: on border of tribe of Judah
definition: כְּסָלוֺן proper name, of a location on border of tribe of Judah = הַריְֿעָרִים Josh 15:10 = Kesla 10 miles west of Jerusalem, Guérin Jud. ii. 11 ff. Mem iii. 25. 26 Buhl G. § 92, p. 166 .
